name: ui-ux-design
description: Design and build user interface screens.

interface.longDescription: Turn requirements into screens people can use. Pages are grouped by design intent: polished, animated landing pages; clear, specific storefronts; and portals focused on business logic and interaction. Plans screen maps, user flows, every UI state, accessibility, and brand themes, then builds the screens in React with a ready-made Base UI and Tailwind CSS kit of about 60 components, so projects start from a complete design system instead of from scratch. Also reviews existing UIs for usability problems.
defaultPrompt: Design the screens for this feature spec
Build a landing page for our app launch
Review this page for usability and accessibility
